note: A working editorial question bank for an original MAIC diploma-labeled course. Not a degree or a verified academic accreditation. Academic signoff required before production activation.

questions.stem: What is the starting point of a social-media marketing strategy?
options: Treat a post count as guaranteed revenue
A defined organizational objective and intended customer action
Use follower numbers as proof of purchases
Assume all practice scores award certificates
questions.rationale: Marketing plans should begin with a measurable purpose. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: Why can frequent posting fail to establish marketing success?
options: Let software interfaces define the strategy
Activity volume does not necessarily produce business outcomes
Avoid checking asset rights
Treat a post count as guaranteed revenue
questions.rationale: Frequency is not a substitute for results. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: What role may organic content play in a marketing plan?
options: Use follower numbers as proof of purchases
Assume all practice scores award certificates
Build information, trust and unpaid audience relationships
Let software interfaces define the strategy
questions.rationale: Organic activity differs from paid impressions. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: What is the appropriate use of platform metrics?
options: Avoid checking asset rights
Interpret defined audience behaviors alongside business evidence
Treat a post count as guaranteed revenue
Use follower numbers as proof of purchases
questions.rationale: Metrics require contextual analysis. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: Why should campaign deliverables be rights-cleared?
options: Assume all practice scores award certificates
Let software interfaces define the strategy
Avoid checking asset rights
The team must have permission to use included assets
questions.rationale: Permissions affect lawful publication. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: What is an appropriate expectation for completing this self-study course?
options: Practice competence, not automatic official certification
Treat a post count as guaranteed revenue
Use follower numbers as proof of purchases
Assume all practice scores award certificates
questions.rationale: Study exercises are separate from formal MAIC assessment. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: What must be considered when a campaign uses sensitive user data?
options: Let software interfaces define the strategy
Avoid checking asset rights
Treat a post count as guaranteed revenue
Privacy and an appropriate basis for its collection and use
questions.rationale: Responsible marketing requires data protection. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: Why should a marketer define the target customer action?
options: It allows a campaign to be evaluated beyond attention
Use follower numbers as proof of purchases
Assume all practice scores award certificates
Let software interfaces define the strategy
questions.rationale: A measurable action connects communications to objectives. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: A hypothetical brand posts 20 items but records no customer actions. What conclusion is warranted?
options: The posts generated exactly 20 sales
Every post achieved the objective
Posting activity has been counted, but business impact remains unproven
The brand has automatically gained a professional credential
questions.rationale: Posting counts alone do not establish results. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: A marketer is given a target of 30 suitable inquiries in a month. What must be agreed before tracking it?
options: Only the preferred background color
A guaranteed audience count
Which post has the most emojis
What suitable means and how inquiries are recorded
questions.rationale: Qualification and counting rules define the objective. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 2.

questions.stem: How does a conversion objective differ from awareness?
options: Choose only a target number of likes
Conversion asks for a defined action rather than only discovery
Ignore the sales team's actual capacity
Assume all visitors are ready to purchase
questions.rationale: Objectives address different customer stages. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: What makes a lead-generation target measurable?
options: Promote an unverified guaranteed sales claim
Use a broken destination behind the call to action
Choose only a target number of likes
A timeframe, qualified-inquiry definition and recording method
questions.rationale: Useful objectives specify an observable outcome. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: Why should the business consider lead-handling capacity?
options: Ignore the sales team's actual capacity
The sales team may be unable to serve every inquiry
Assume all visitors are ready to purchase
Promote an unverified guaranteed sales claim
questions.rationale: A target must be operationally feasible. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: What is customer positioning intended to explain?
options: Use a broken destination behind the call to action
Why the offer solves a relevant problem for a defined group
Choose only a target number of likes
Ignore the sales team's actual capacity
questions.rationale: Positioning connects need and value. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: What is a risk of promising guaranteed sales growth?
options: Assume all visitors are ready to purchase
Promote an unverified guaranteed sales claim
Use a broken destination behind the call to action
It may be unsupported by credible performance evidence
questions.rationale: Marketing claims must be substantiated. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: Which stage commonly follows initial product discovery?
options: Customer evaluation and comparison of available options
Choose only a target number of likes
Ignore the sales team's actual capacity
Assume all visitors are ready to purchase
questions.rationale: The journey can include consideration before action. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: Why can a customer case study need verification?
options: Promote an unverified guaranteed sales claim
Reported results must be distinguished from hypothetical models
Use a broken destination behind the call to action
Choose only a target number of likes
questions.rationale: Case studies should not invent customer outcomes. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: What should a quote-request landing page provide?
options: Ignore the sales team's actual capacity
Assume all visitors are ready to purchase
Promote an unverified guaranteed sales claim
A clear working way to request information and understand next steps
questions.rationale: The destination must match the call to action. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: A firm's sales team can handle only 15 new cases in a period. What should marketing consider?
options: Assume the team can serve unlimited demand
Use likes as evidence that cases are handled
Ignore all incoming customer inquiries
Lead capacity before increasing campaign volume
questions.rationale: Feasibility limits useful lead volume. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: An awareness video gets 5,000 views but no tracked form visits. What remains uncertain?
options: Whether it generated the intended qualified inquiries
That the video played 5,000 times under the metric
That awareness content was published
That viewers could see the message
questions.rationale: Views and qualified inquiry actions are different. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 3.

questions.stem: How should audience personas be treated initially?
options: Treat personas as verified individual facts
Use follower counts as direct profit evidence
Ignore current platform policies and available resources
Research-informed hypotheses rather than fixed stereotypes
questions.rationale: Personas should be revised with evidence. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: Which factor can matter for a B2B purchasing process?
options: Assume all residents have identical needs
Pick channels only because they are fashionable
Different people may research and approve the purchase
Treat personas as verified individual facts
questions.rationale: Organizational purchase roles may differ. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: What is a danger of assuming everyone in a location wants one offer?
options: Use follower counts as direct profit evidence
Ignore current platform policies and available resources
It ignores distinct needs and service contexts
Assume all residents have identical needs
questions.rationale: Geography alone does not define demand. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: Which evidence can help understand recurring customer questions?
options: Support records and ethically obtained interviews
Pick channels only because they are fashionable
Treat personas as verified individual facts
Use follower counts as direct profit evidence
questions.rationale: Direct inquiries can reveal customer needs. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: What can a competitor's public engagement fail to prove?
options: Ignore current platform policies and available resources
Its actual profit or customer conversion performance
Assume all residents have identical needs
Pick channels only because they are fashionable
questions.rationale: Visible social metrics have limited meaning. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: How should a business decide which social channels to prioritize?
options: Evaluate audience fit, format and available operating resources
Treat personas as verified individual facts
Use follower counts as direct profit evidence
Ignore current platform policies and available resources
questions.rationale: Channel selection depends on feasible usefulness. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: Why might a technical B2B supplier prefer explanatory content?
options: Assume all residents have identical needs
Buyers may need evidence and detail before contacting sales
Pick channels only because they are fashionable
Treat personas as verified individual facts
questions.rationale: Channel content should fit information needs. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: What must marketers remember about platform advertising controls?
options: Specific features and policies may change over time
Use follower counts as direct profit evidence
Ignore current platform policies and available resources
Assume all residents have identical needs
questions.rationale: Tool functionality should be verified before launch. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: A product is useful only to local firms. Which audience choice is defensible?
options: Reach firms in the actual service area with a relevant need
Target every country regardless of ability to serve
Assume all viewers are potential buyers
Select a random age segment without evidence
questions.rationale: Segmenting should consider service feasibility. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: A rival has 10,000 likes on a post. Which business outcome is not proven?
options: That a public engagement number exists
The rival earned a profit from that post
That users reacted to the content
That a social account published the item
questions.rationale: Engagement does not directly establish financial results. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 4.

questions.stem: What is a content pillar?
options: Invent customer testimonials for a stronger story
A recurring category of useful topics aligned with the audience
Use an unreadable call to action
Assume a synthetic image is automatically a genuine case study
questions.rationale: Pillars organize consistent messaging. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: Why should a creative brief record factual sources?
options: Make the video claim guaranteed sales results
Separate content entirely from user questions
Invent customer testimonials for a stronger story
Claims in the content should be verifiable
questions.rationale: Content production needs evidence. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: What is a risk of presenting a synthetic face as a real testimonial?
options: Use an unreadable call to action
Assume a synthetic image is automatically a genuine case study
It invents evidence of a customer's experience
Make the video claim guaranteed sales results
questions.rationale: Generated imagery must not impersonate genuine testimony. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: What should a short marketing video establish early?
options: Separate content entirely from user questions
The relevant problem or topic without unsupported promises
Invent customer testimonials for a stronger story
Use an unreadable call to action
questions.rationale: A clear opening supports comprehension. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: What makes a call to action suitable?
options: Assume a synthetic image is automatically a genuine case study
Make the video claim guaranteed sales results
It accurately matches a usable destination and requested action
Separate content entirely from user questions
questions.rationale: The link should fulfill the promised next step. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: Why adapt layouts while preserving the brand identity?
options: Invent customer testimonials for a stronger story
Different placements require legible formats without inconsistent branding
Use an unreadable call to action
Assume a synthetic image is automatically a genuine case study
questions.rationale: Design must fit destination screens. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: Which claim requires particularly strong substantiation?
options: Make the video claim guaranteed sales results
Separate content entirely from user questions
A prediction that the service guarantees a sales increase
Invent customer testimonials for a stronger story
questions.rationale: Outcome guarantees need evidence. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: How may an educational content pillar help a service company?
options: Use an unreadable call to action
Assume a synthetic image is automatically a genuine case study
Answer practical questions before a buyer makes contact
Make the video claim guaranteed sales results
questions.rationale: Helpful information supports consideration. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: A scripted customer story has no actual customer behind it. How should it be used?
options: As verified customer evidence
As a quote from an unnamed real buyer
As an explicitly hypothetical illustration, not a testimonial
As an audited case result
questions.rationale: Invented stories cannot become real testimonials. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: A services ad links to a page with no inquiry form despite promising immediate quotes. What is wrong?
options: The ad cannot contain any text
The campaign is automatically successful
The promise is verified by the link itself
The call to action and destination do not match
questions.rationale: The next step must be usable and truthful. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 5.

questions.stem: What information belongs in a content calendar?
options: Post date, audience, owner, objective, rights and review status
Buy imaginary positive customer reviews
Replace service assistance with promotional slogans
Schedule posts with no owner or review
questions.rationale: Calendars coordinate accountable production. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: Why can fewer posts be preferable to daily posting?
options: Ask users to publish passwords in comments
Delete every negative comment regardless of substance
Buy imaginary positive customer reviews
A small team may lack resources for accurate review and response
questions.rationale: Quality and feasibility matter more than frequency alone. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: What is an appropriate first response to a service complaint?
options: Replace service assistance with promotional slogans
Schedule posts with no owner or review
Acknowledge the issue and route it to a responsible team
Ask users to publish passwords in comments
questions.rationale: Customer care is not the same as promotion. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: Why should private account information not be requested in public comments?
options: Delete every negative comment regardless of substance
Buy imaginary positive customer reviews
It can expose sensitive customer details
Replace service assistance with promotional slogans
questions.rationale: Community support should protect privacy. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: What is wrong with purchasing fabricated reviews?
options: They misrepresent customer experience and manipulate trust
Schedule posts with no owner or review
Ask users to publish passwords in comments
Delete every negative comment regardless of substance
questions.rationale: Authentic feedback is essential. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: Why name an escalation owner for sensitive allegations?
options: Staff need a responsible review route for potentially harmful claims
Buy imaginary positive customer reviews
Replace service assistance with promotional slogans
Schedule posts with no owner or review
questions.rationale: Moderation requires accountability. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: How should moderation treat critical but lawful feedback?
options: Ask users to publish passwords in comments
Evaluate it fairly rather than delete it for being negative
Delete every negative comment regardless of substance
Buy imaginary positive customer reviews
questions.rationale: Disagreement alone is not proof of abuse. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: What should happen if staff cannot verify a requested price?
options: Avoid inventing a quote and route the inquiry for confirmation
Replace service assistance with promotional slogans
Schedule posts with no owner or review
Ask users to publish passwords in comments
questions.rationale: Customer communications must be accurate. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: A small team can fact-check four weekly posts but not seven. What is the sensible schedule?
options: Publish seven unreviewed items
Replace missing posts with fake reviews
Plan four reliable items and adequate response coverage
Leave all comments unanswered forever
questions.rationale: Real capacity should shape the calendar. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: A commenter posts a private order number publicly. What should support staff do?
options: Move sensitive verification to an appropriate secure channel
Request account passwords publicly
Forward the order number to all followers
Use the disclosure as a paid promotion
questions.rationale: Public discussions should limit private data exposure. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 6.

questions.stem: What must be defined before evaluating CPC?
options: Ad spend and a consistent counted-click definition
Treat every click as a confirmed customer
Assume cheaper traffic is always qualified
Use no budget ceiling or stopping rule
questions.rationale: A ratio depends on its inputs. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: Which metric commonly counts recorded ad displays?
options: Ignore the destination page completely
Change all test variables simultaneously
Treat every click as a confirmed customer
Impressions
questions.rationale: Impressions are a display-based measure. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: Why do clicks not necessarily equal customers?
options: Assume cheaper traffic is always qualified
Many clickers do not complete a qualifying purchase or inquiry
Use no budget ceiling or stopping rule
Ignore the destination page completely
questions.rationale: Clicking is not conversion. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: Why compare paid creatives under similar conditions?
options: Change all test variables simultaneously
Treat every click as a confirmed customer
Assume cheaper traffic is always qualified
Otherwise differences may reflect audience or offer changes
questions.rationale: Comparable experiments improve interpretation. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: What should accompany a campaign's budget ceiling?
options: Use no budget ceiling or stopping rule
A conversion goal and stop or review criteria
Ignore the destination page completely
Change all test variables simultaneously
questions.rationale: A controlled test should have a decision rule. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: What is a risk of a misleading paid-ad promise?
options: Treat every click as a confirmed customer
Assume cheaper traffic is always qualified
It may generate poor-quality inquiries and harm trust
Use no budget ceiling or stopping rule
questions.rationale: Cheap attention is not reliable performance. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: Why check the landing page before running a paid ad?
options: Its content and functionality must match the creative
Ignore the destination page completely
Change all test variables simultaneously
Treat every click as a confirmed customer
questions.rationale: A broken destination undermines campaign validity. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: What is the role of campaign frequency analysis?
options: Assume cheaper traffic is always qualified
Assess how often an audience is seeing a defined ad
Use no budget ceiling or stopping rule
Ignore the destination page completely
questions.rationale: Repeated exposures may affect outcomes and costs. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: An ad spends $120 for 240 defined clicks. What is CPC?
questions.rationale: CPC is advertising spend divided by counted clicks. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: An ad records 150 clicks from 3,000 impressions. What is CTR?
questions.rationale: 150 divided by 3000 times 100 is five percent. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 7.

questions.stem: What should a creator partnership brief define?
options: Use follower count as proof of every result
Invent firsthand product experiences
Deliverables, disclosure duties, rights, compensation and review
Treat platform labels as universal legal compliance
questions.rationale: Written expectations help ethical execution. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: Why is follower count alone a weak partner-selection criterion?
options: It does not establish audience fit or useful outcomes
Hide compensation or gifted products
Assume all creator content is free for unlimited reuse
Use follower count as proof of every result
questions.rationale: Engagement quality and relevance matter. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: What kind of brand relationship may need influencer disclosure?
options: Payment, a gifted product or another material benefit
Invent firsthand product experiences
Treat platform labels as universal legal compliance
Hide compensation or gifted products
questions.rationale: Material ties may affect endorsement transparency. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: Where should a disclosure be placed?
options: Assume all creator content is free for unlimited reuse
Use follower count as proof of every result
Invent firsthand product experiences
Where it is clear and difficult for the audience to miss
questions.rationale: Disclosure should accompany the endorsement. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: Why should a creator avoid a product experience they never had?
options: Treat platform labels as universal legal compliance
Hide compensation or gifted products
Assume all creator content is free for unlimited reuse
It would be a fabricated testimonial
questions.rationale: Endorsements should reflect actual experience. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: What must be confirmed before reusing an influencer's video in an ad?
options: Use follower count as proof of every result
Invent firsthand product experiences
Treat platform labels as universal legal compliance
The intended reuse rights and restrictions
questions.rationale: Creator content licenses may limit distribution. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: Why check applicable jurisdiction for sponsored posts?
options: Hide compensation or gifted products
Assume all creator content is free for unlimited reuse
Use follower count as proof of every result
Disclosure duties vary among locations and audiences
questions.rationale: Rules should not be assumed universal. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes platform disclosure tools?
options: Invent firsthand product experiences
Treat platform labels as universal legal compliance
They may help but do not always replace the required disclosure
Hide compensation or gifted products
questions.rationale: Compliance cannot rely on a single automatic label. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: A creator receives free access to a paid software service and promotes it. What should be assessed?
options: Whether followers already know automatically
Whether the platform logo waives all obligations
Whether the material relationship requires clear disclosure
Whether a gift can never be relevant
questions.rationale: Noncash benefits can still be material relationships. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: A creator licenses a video for one sponsored post. May it automatically be placed in ten paid ads?
options: No, the permitted scope of reuse needs checking
Yes, all creator videos are public domain
Yes, because it contains the brand name
Yes, after the first upload
questions.rationale: Usage rights may be limited by format and quantity. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 8.

questions.stem: What is a conversion-rate denominator in a campaign report?
options: Treat ROAS as profit after all costs
Assume all attribution systems count identically
The defined total eligible visits or interactions used in the rate
Ignore repeated visits and excluded records
questions.rationale: A useful rate must state what is counted. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: Why can analytics and ad reports show different conversion counts?
options: Compare rates with unspecified denominators
They may apply different attribution and counting rules
Treat every completed form as a qualified lead
Treat ROAS as profit after all costs
questions.rationale: Reporting definitions affect credited outcomes. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: What does ROAS compare?
options: Assume all attribution systems count identically
Ignore repeated visits and excluded records
Attributed revenue with advertising spend
Compare rates with unspecified denominators
questions.rationale: ROAS is a revenue-to-ad-spend ratio. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: Why is ROAS not equivalent to business profit?
options: Treat every completed form as a qualified lead
Fulfillment and other operating costs remain outside the ratio
Treat ROAS as profit after all costs
Assume all attribution systems count identically
questions.rationale: Revenue does not equal net profit. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: What is a key event in a web analytics context?
options: Ignore repeated visits and excluded records
Compare rates with unspecified denominators
A recorded action important to site or business evaluation
Treat every completed form as a qualified lead
questions.rationale: Key events measure defined valuable behaviors. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: Why should a marketing dashboard document exclusions?
options: Treat ROAS as profit after all costs
Assume all attribution systems count identically
Ignore repeated visits and excluded records
Missing or excluded observations may change reported performance
questions.rationale: Data cleaning choices affect denominators. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: What is an example of an attribution limitation?
options: A person may return directly after an earlier ad interaction
Compare rates with unspecified denominators
Treat every completed form as a qualified lead
Treat ROAS as profit after all costs
questions.rationale: Customer journeys can involve multiple touchpoints. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: Why might a high form-completion count overstate sales usefulness?
options: Assume all attribution systems count identically
Ignore repeated visits and excluded records
Compare rates with unspecified denominators
Some forms may not meet the qualified-lead definition
questions.rationale: Conversion quality matters. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: A landing page records 30 eligible form completions from 600 visits. What is its conversion rate?
questions.rationale: Thirty divided by six hundred is five percent. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: Attributed sales revenue is $900 and ad spend is $300. What is ROAS?
questions.rationale: Revenue divided by advertising spend equals three, before other costs. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 9.

questions.stem: What should a campaign hypothesis specify?
options: Claim a test proves causation after one day
Ignore complaints and lead quality
An intervention and the outcome it is intended to change
Continue advertising a known false statement
questions.rationale: Tests should be decision-oriented. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: Why limit multiple simultaneous changes in a test?
options: They make it difficult to identify which change affected results
Change creative, audience and offer simultaneously
Use sensitive contact lists without checking permissions
Claim a test proves causation after one day
questions.rationale: Controlled comparison supports interpretation. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: Why can one highly successful day be weak evidence?
options: Short samples and unusual conditions can mislead
Ignore complaints and lead quality
Continue advertising a known false statement
Change creative, audience and offer simultaneously
questions.rationale: Results need representative observation. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: What is a balancing metric for paid lead generation?
options: Use sensitive contact lists without checking permissions
Claim a test proves causation after one day
Quality of inquiries or customer complaints
Ignore complaints and lead quality
questions.rationale: A primary rate can hide harmful consequences. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: What may make a high-click ad strategically unsuccessful?
options: Continue advertising a known false statement
The clicks are driven by unsupported or misleading claims
Change creative, audience and offer simultaneously
Use sensitive contact lists without checking permissions
questions.rationale: Engagement without integrity can harm the business. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: Why should the source of customer contact data be evaluated?
options: Claim a test proves causation after one day
Ignore complaints and lead quality
Targeting must respect privacy and applicable permissions
Continue advertising a known false statement
questions.rationale: Responsible campaigns require lawful data handling. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: What is an appropriate stop condition for an advertisement?
options: Change creative, audience and offer simultaneously
A verified material false claim in the active creative
Use sensitive contact lists without checking permissions
Claim a test proves causation after one day
questions.rationale: Factual errors should trigger correction. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: How should an experiment result be reported?
options: Ignore complaints and lead quality
With observed evidence, limitations and a proposed next action
Continue advertising a known false statement
Change creative, audience and offer simultaneously
questions.rationale: Avoid declaring certainty from limited correlation. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: Test A produces lower CPC but far more unqualified inquiries. What should govern the next decision?
options: Scale A solely because clicks are cheapest
Cost per useful lead and balancing outcomes, not CPC alone
Ignore sales team feedback
Treat all leads as equally valuable
questions.rationale: Lead quality can outweigh inexpensive clicks. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: A campaign receives only two conversions after one day. How should its apparent lift be treated?
options: As guaranteed permanent growth
As proof that every platform works equally
As automatic justification to double all budgets
As limited evidence needing more reliable comparison
questions.rationale: Small samples can yield unstable results. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 10.

questions.stem: What is the hypothetical web-design campaign's objective?
options: Call raw clicks confirmed paying clients
Present a fictional prototype as a proven customer's result
Assume all inquiries have equal value
Generate suitable restaurant inquiries within a limited 30-day budget
questions.rationale: The fictional case connects inquiries, capacity and spend. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 11.

questions.stem: Why are restaurant owners and managers separate audience segments?
options: Exceed available sales handling without planning
Use unverified claims in the paid creatives
They may have different needs and purchase roles
Call raw clicks confirmed paying clients
questions.rationale: Segment context can change objections. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 11.

questions.stem: What must the sample reservation-flow demonstration avoid claiming?
options: Present a fictional prototype as a proven customer's result
Assume all inquiries have equal value
That it is a documented real customer's outcome
Exceed available sales handling without planning
questions.rationale: Hypothetical demonstrations must stay labeled. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 11.

questions.stem: What is the stated monthly sales-handling capacity in the case?
options: Use unverified claims in the paid creatives
20 qualified inquiries
Call raw clicks confirmed paying clients
Present a fictional prototype as a proven customer's result
questions.rationale: The case specifies a team limit. Source: MAIC Diploma in Social Media Marketing and Strategy, page 11.

questions.stem: Why are qualified inquiries more useful than raw clicks for this agency?
options: Assume all inquiries have equal value
Exceed available sales handling without planning
